question: What is the significance of the constant washing of the mouth in this practice?
premises: The washing of the mouth is performed constantly.
This act is directed upward toward Brahman.
The instruction is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as an upward movement toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The esoteric meaning of mukha-prakṣālanaṃ as ūrddha-gatam to Brahman is symbolic and open to interpretation.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is an upward movement toward Brahman.
